LanguageData.Raven_Hediff_KidneyDeficiency.label: (Raven) Severe Kidney Deficiency
LanguageData.Raven_Hediff_KidneyDeficiency.descriptio: This wretched male has endured an inhumanly endless extraction of semen. His kidneys howl in protest and his body is utterly drained. Only rest can slowly restore him over time.
